checks.name: Loading has only a small status notice, no fullscreen screen or entry CTA
Successful preparation automatically enables map and assistant without a click
Actual W pans in the camera-relative direction with unchanged zoom/height
Actual S pans in the camera-relative direction with unchanged zoom/height
Actual A pans in the camera-relative direction with unchanged zoom/height
Actual D pans in the camera-relative direction with unchanged zoom/height
WASD typing in the assistant never pans or consumes characters
Window blur clears held keys and prevents stuck travel
Gould has one shared Stern root and no separate selectable entry
Grouping preserves original Stern and plaza world-space geometry bounds
Hover over plaza lifts both plaza and Stern together
Actual asset failure denies automatic entry and keeps recoverable retry

limitations: Direct checks by primary agent, not independently delegated. Isolated installed Chrome; physical keyboard/touch not tested. API status mocked; no model/backend calls.
